purpose: 선택 욕구의 첫 결과가 운명 확정이 아니라 되돌아올 표식과 다음 판단 표식 사이의 끊긴 별빛으로 남는 constellation-afterglow 12개 편집 검토안이다.

renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium choice-desire constellation-afterglow guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair; no extra guardian, adviser, family member, audience, future self, human, silhouette, reflection or implied person. Preserve canonical identity, colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or pair plus one bounded first-choice result, one return marker and one separated review marker covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Show broken non-deterministic starlight between the return marker and unfinished review marker; never declare a correct choice, destiny, guaranteed peace, status or future outcome. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Doors, pads, seals, markers, tokens and bays remain ajar, removable, unnamed or open-ended. Libra may use exactly one abstract choice balance; no other sign uses a scale. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign or deterministic route. Keep every composition distinct. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, paper grain, plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
